description: Deposit money into your RentAHuman wallet by paying USDC on Base via the x402 protocol — no card, no checkout page. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY and RENTAHUMAN_X402_PRIVATE_KEY (an EVM key whose address holds USDC on Base; gasless — no ETH needed). The deposit is credited 1:1 as spendable balance. Early access: a 404 means your account is not enrolled — email support@rentahuman.ai.

amountCents.description: Amount to deposit in integer cents ($1.00–$10,000). Paid in USDC on Base; credited to your wallet 1:1.
amountCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)

name: x402_fund_wallet
